name: Qualitative and Quantitative Methods in Design
description: By the end of the course, the students will be able to frame research questions and hypotheses in the context of real-world design challenges. Conduct user research using qualitative and quantitative methods. Understand and apply mixed-method approaches to inform design. Use data to generate insights, prototypes, and design decisions. Critically evaluate evidence and communicate findings through visual and analytical means.
